name: TAS (Text Augmented Spatial-aware Zero-shot RIS, EMNLP Findings 2023)
reason: the released entry point requires a precomputed per-sentence overall-caption file `overall_caption_path/overall_caption_{dataset}_{split}_{splitby}.json` (tas_main.py loads it unconditionally); the repository ships neither the file nor a script that creates it, and README step 3 asks the user to prepare captions with BLIP-2. It also requires the spaCy transformer model en_core_web_trf, a torch.jit ViT-B/32 checkpoint, and SAM-H, CLIP and BLIP-2 weights; as released the pipeline is not executable without first generating the missing data file.
